gloss: to mediate; to act as an intermediary; to broker

definitions.gloss: to mediate; to act as an intermediary; to broker
definitions.explanation: To act as a go-between to facilitate a deal, agreement, or resolution between two parties. Common in real estate, business, and diplomacy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仲介|ちゅうかい}する。
examples.english: To broker a real estate deal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仲介|ちゅうかい}して⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: A friend mediated between the two of them.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{仲介|ちゅうかい}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{安心|あんしん}して→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: A specialized broker is handling this transaction, so please rest assured.

notes:
Very commonly used in real estate (⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦{仲介|ちゅうかい}→仲介：09718_chuukai⟧) and business contexts. The noun form ⟦{仲介|ちゅうかい}→仲介：09718_chuukai⟧ is often used as a modifier meaning "intermediary" or "brokerage."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仲介|ちゅうかい}→仲介：09718_chuukai⟧⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧: broker, intermediary agent
- ⟦{仲介|ちゅうかい}{手数料|てすうりょう}→仲介手数料：10290_chuukaitesuuryou⟧: brokerage fee, commission
- ⟦{仲介|ちゅうかい}→仲介：09718_chuukai⟧⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧: mediator role
- ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦{仲介|ちゅうかい}→仲介：09718_chuukai⟧: real estate brokerage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{媒介|ばいかい}→媒介：15990_baikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to mediate — more formal/technical, also used in science for disease transmission
- ⟦{調停|ちょうてい}→調停：14251_choutei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to arbitrate — legal context, formal dispute resolution
- ⟦{取|と}り{持|も}つ→取り持つ：09988_torimotsu⟧: to mediate — more informal, acting as a go-between in personal relationships
